peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (52.0): 3.1 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 198 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 13). Context, not scored: resales in 8.3% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: The first resale wave ended before the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity. First resale wave from Dec 2022 (analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date).

wave.basisLabel: analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Eunos MRT about 510 m, Paya Lebar MRT about 830 m; closer than 317 of 662 similar developments (the same as 10). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 8 within 2 km; nearest Haig Girls' School about 510 m; more than 126 of 662 similar developments (the same as 165). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 8 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 160 m), more than 281 of 662 similar developments (the same as 80); nearest hawker centre Geylang Serai Market about 250 m; nearest park Marine Parade Rd Park about 1,470 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Verdé Joo Chiat, 9 new sales, about 290 m; Koon Seng House, 6 new sales, about 610 m; Claydence, 8 new sales, about 720 m; The Continuum, 208 new sales, about 820 m; K Suites, 6 new sales, about 920 m; Straits at Joo Chiat, 3 new sales, about 920 m; Ardor Residence, 13 new sales, about 1,030 m; Tembusu Grand, 11 new sales, about 1,160 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 495 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 371 new sales and 1,033 resales (1,404 purchases); new sales were 26.4% of these purchases. Subsales (22) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 1,033 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 624 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,033 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,167 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−11.5%). Planning-area private resales −17.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
